review_notes: I read all of Support.lean (lines 1–90). Its lemmas are `support_cons`, `weight_cons`, `repeat_or_new` and `grouped_prime_sum`. Each proves a different statement, and no nontrivial reasoning is duplicated between them. I then searched the sibling files for repeats. The same step, splitting a sum over `Fin (n+1) → P` into `p` and `Fin.cons p x` via `Fin.consEquiv` and `Fintype.sum_prod_type`, appears in `grouped_prime_sum`, `EarlierTuple.lean` (`triangular_product_sum`), `BinWeight.lean` and `AbsoluteDefect/SumFinFunSucc.lean` (`sum_fin_fun_succ`). In each place it is only a one- or two-line rewrite. The `SumFinFunSucc` version is already a helper, but it is stated for ℂ-valued functions. A generalised helper would be a thin wrapper around existing Mathlib API, which the rubric does not count as repeated proof machinery. I did not open BinWeight.lean in full. I found no other repeated blocks.
